payload.title: Implement and falsify ClayCode effect-authority closure in APP-08
payload.work_clay: Implement the current G9 rule model_intent_and_effect_authority_separate in the first real ClayCode type/effect checker, lowering, runtime ABI and FFI gateway. Treat serialized CapabilityRef/descriptor state as non-authorizing; require independently validated opaque/sealed bearer possession or an equivalently strong signed capability mechanism. Enforce transitive child authority closure across Python/Bash/WASM/native subprocess and FFI adapters.
payload.reason_clay: Spawn run spawn_20260809T1741p0700_claycode_effect_authority_lowering produced two proxy counterexamples: structural field-only capability validation accepted 20000/20000 forgeries; ambient-host lowering bypassed the broker in 10000/10000 unauthorized cases. Brokered/opaque controls produced zero unauthorized accepts in the tested proxy corpus. Real compiler/Ubuntu evidence is still absent.
payload.completion_clay: Execute APP-08 on the Ubuntu developer target with valid reversible effects plus forged descriptors, copied/stale/revoked refs, attenuation/delegation, generated child code, confused-deputy/path substitution, restart/replay and brokered-vs-ambient differential. Record source semantic hash, effect manifest hash, adapter ABI/set hash, capability-scope hash, target hash, environment identity and exact outcomes. PASS only if ordinary utility remains available and tested unauthorized protected effects are unreachable.
